title: MapleStory M Basic UI Guide
author: MapleStory M GM
summary: A first-party map of the MapleStory M in-game interface, covering character and map information, quests and parties, progression menus, Maple Viewer modes, inventory, mail, settings, and shops.

sections.title: Character, maps, and movement
items: The main screen exposes character name, level, HP, MP, and combat power.
Road Map describes the current town, while World Map describes the current continent.
The on-screen controller supports forward, backward, horizontal, and diagonal movement.

sections.title: Quests, parties, and guide missions
items: The Mini Quest Window displays current quest information and achievement progress.
The Mini Party Window can create, invite, recruit, search, and auto-join parties.
Guide Missions introduce game features and provide rewards based on mission type.

sections.title: Progression menus
items: Legion shows World character count, cumulative-level effects, and grid synergy.
V Matrix manages, enhances, extracts, and crafts V Cores.
Arcane Symbol manages owned symbols, while Monster Collection tracks discovered areas and exploration.

sections.title: Utilities and account-wide screens
items: Maple Viewer switches between Auto-Battle, Manual Battle, Boss Battle, Screenshot, and Sleep Screen modes.
Bag separates owned items by type, and Mail distinguishes account-visible Default mail from character-specific Personal mail.
Options, Cash Shop, Package, Styling, Android, and Change Character remain separate interface destinations.

notes: Structured summary verified from Nexon's official MapleStory M forum guide on 2026-07-27.
prerequisites: Access to the MapleStory M in-game interface
steps: Identify the character, map, quest, and party areas on the main screen.
Open Menu and locate progression systems such as Legion, V Matrix, and Arcane Symbol.
Review Bag and both Mail categories before claiming or moving items.
Select the appropriate Maple Viewer mode for the current activity.
Use Options to confirm account and gameplay settings.
